artworks.label: Golden ginkgo fruit
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for ginkgo-hour. A compact natural ginkgo twig carrying three ripe golden-amber ginkgo fruits, one fruit split to reveal a smooth ivory seed, one small curled fan leaf resting beside the fruit cluster. Fine-art botanical still-life macro photography, delicate speckled skin, authentic warm brown twig, subtle translucent golden leaf veins, cream/ochre/amber and muted olive palette, diffuse autumn daylight. Fruits and seed are the focal subject; no ink bottle or mobile. Entire compact subject centered with generous18percent empty margins, readable at small size. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no floor, opaque square, frame, panel or collage. Pure art: absolutely no lettering, text, numbers, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Never copy/crop/recolour existing art.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
